title: Claude background-end association does not revalidate its candidate and rival sets when it installs the artifact
outcome: When a Claude background-end match installs its artifact, it rechecks under the lock that the candidate and rival sets it matched on are unchanged, and records ArtifactLocatorAmbiguous (or an equivalent reason) when a new same-window registration or rival appeared.
acceptance: Claude background-end association does not revalidate its candidate and rival sets when it installs the artifact is done
